source_active_path: UE 5.8 desktop Deferred; all four ShadingPathSwitch inputs[0] selected

subsurface_formula.units: UE integrates SubsurfaceColor as extinction per meter; kernel converts to per-kilometer once for Feng transport.

coordinates.input: Godot absolute world position in kilometers
coordinates.basis: UE = (Godot.x, -Godot.z, Godot.y), preserving right-handedness; wind_offset_km is added in Godot world space before basis conversion and only affects material coordinates.
coordinates.global_placement_evidence: VectorParameter_18 has no serialized DefaultValue; parent material and instance have no override; VectorParameter CDO remains zero-initialized. It drives both placement and Rotator time, so the default rotation is zero.
coordinates.truncate_lwc: Source graph applies TruncateLWC after the world-position-to-global-scale division. Kernel receives float-kilometer coordinates and treats that conversion as identity.

texture_sampling.pattern: T_CloudPattern; linear; shared Wrap sampler; the material node is TMVM_None, but UE cloud view, reflection, shadow, and SkyAO paths force mip 0 (USE_FORCE_TEXTURE_MIP=1). The kernel uses textureLod(...,0) to preserve that renderer contract; RGB drives ConservativeDensity R/G and profile coordinates.
texture_sampling.cloud_mask: T_CloudMask; linear; shared Wrap sampler; sample at mip 0 to match UE's forced cloud-view, shadow, and SkyAO mip; RGB enters the graph mask expression.
texture_sampling.height_profile: T_Profile_08; linear; shared Wrap sampler; explicit MipLevel=0; three samples at (normalized altitude, matching pattern R/G/B), selecting corresponding R/G/B.
texture_sampling.shape_noise: VT_PerlinWorley_Balanced; linear; shared Wrap sampler; sample12 uses R at explicit mip0 to warp sample9 coordinates; sample9 uses G at explicit mip0 for ConservativeDensity A.

pattern_runtime_mip_chain.description: Pinned source-order float32 CPU reference of legacy TMGS_Blur1, from the 1024 source through the 256 size cap and full 256-to-1 mip chain; Godot save/reload preserves the uncompressed RGBAF mip payload. This is not platform-cooked UE texture output.

texture_sampling.time_texture_size: TextureProperty_1 defaults to TMTM_TextureSize; Divide_2 divides the actual runtime Pattern width by Layout_CloudGlobalScale (256.0), and Multiply_26 multiplies that ratio by 1000.0 for the Time divisor.

forced_mip_source.contract: These stages set USE_FORCE_TEXTURE_MIP=1; MaterialTemplate.ush applies forced level 0 when the graph node has no explicit mip. The same kernel sample at mip 0 is used by cloud trace, cloud shadow, and SkyAO dispatches.

source_headers: Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Public/Materials/MaterialExpressionIf.h:40 (ConstB=0); serialized input pins and threshold override are used where present
Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Public/Materials/MaterialExpressionWorldPosition.h:20-24 (default WPT_Default: absolute world position including material offsets)

Engine/Source/Runtime/Core/Public/Math/Color.h:126 (FLinearColor defaulted constructor); MaterialExpressionVectorParameter CDO constructor at MaterialExpressions.cpp:8014-8028 does not assign DefaultValue
constructor_and_pin_defaults.unserialized_constants: MaterialExpressionConstant_3 and _6 have no serialized R; MaterialExpressions.cpp:5057-5063 does not assign R, so their zero-initialized CDO value makes the connected noise mip inputs explicit LOD 0. Constant_5 is likewise CDO-zero for both If greater/less branches. Constant3Vector_2 is serialized as (0.5,0.5,0).

output_index_coercions.append_vector_1: A receives WindControls.rgb * WindControls.a; B receives fmod(Time,9999999) / ((PatternTextureSize.x / 256.0) * 1000.0), yielding RGB wind and A time before masks select them.

known_scope_limits: This implements the serialized default MI active Deferred graph, not UE Forward/Mobile shading paths or arbitrary material graph editing.

T_CloudPattern source is 1024x1024 with MaxTextureSize 256; UE TextureProperty resolves the built runtime resource size (256x256 for this asset), and the kernel uses textureSize(pattern,0).x for that same input. The runtime RGBAF texture uses the pinned source-order float32 CPU reference chain for legacy TMGS_Blur1 from mip 256 through mip 1; Godot image save/reload preserves that chain byte-for-byte. This reference is not UE cooker/DDC output, so platform-cooked texel identity is not claimed; GPU output parity remains unvalidated.
The shader language/kernel is specialized for the supplied UE default texture set; custom kernels remain a separate path.
